principles: Separate game/world facts from planning profiles, playthrough state, and derived analytics.
Treat district display letters as labels, never primary keys.
Represent recommendations as parameterized strategy-profile defaults, not game facts.
Keep playthrough state empty in the reusable package.
Do not use image-derived coordinate/proximity datasets in v1.
Derived summaries/checks must be regenerated from canonical/reference + plan inputs.

tables.planning/legacy/rocky_desert/resource_so: Known non-image-derived world resource-source facts currently available for Rocky Desert analysis.
tables.game/reference/logistics_capabilities.cs: Known logistics capability facts used by parameterized phase templates.
Automatic alternate-recipe eligibility rows extracted from the supplied progression document.
tables.game/reference/mam_pool_effects.csv: MAM research-node pool effects preserved as source text.
tables.planning/plans/common/districts.csv: District template definitions across four starts.
tables.planning/plans/common/capacity_targets.c: Shared relaxed-playthrough planning targets; parameterized, not playthrough state.
tables.planning/plans/rocky_desert/resource_ass: Rocky baseline planning-profile assignments; world facts removed.
tables.planning/plans/rocky_desert/sites.csv: Rocky specialty satellite sites separated from District G.
tables.planning/plans/rocky_desert/recipe_prefe: Rocky recipe ranking strategy profile; explicitly parameterized.
tables.planning/playthroughs/template/*: Empty state tables so no current-playthrough decisions are embedded.

online_population_pass.policy: Authoritative online facts are stored separately from parameterized strategy. Conflicts are logged in analysis/qa/discrepancies.csv rather than silently reconciled.

canonical_game_data.policy: For this exact hash, installed Docs data supersedes wiki/community recipe and schematic-unlock claims.
canonical_game_data.recipe_inclusion_rule: Recipe is included in factory-production tables when mProducedIn contains a supported automated production building class; gameplay tags are not used as the inclusion criterion.

rocky_phase_topology_v1.scope: district phases A-G; production topology and adjacency for A/C; conservative scaffolding for B/D/E/F/G
rocky_phase_topology_v1.placement_policy: No exact machine coordinates. Layout guidance stops at module adjacency, lane separation, storage relationship, and expansion intent.

rocky_phase_topology_v1_1.storage_default: central_terminal with consumer priority before storage and overflow-to-shared-sink
rocky_phase_topology_v1_1.topology_semantics: flow relationships and spatial preferences stored separately
rocky_phase_topology_v1_1.district_c_transition: default beam-based EIB phase precedes Encased Industrial Pipe transition

scim_road_overlay_v1.source: user-provided SCIM screenshot with Roads layer visible
